function: Learned TD3 control of the RIS phase vector (N elements) from EKF-predicted user position and channels, to maximize downlink energy efficiency in a multi-satellite LEO network (pp. 5-6).
system: M=2-12 single-antenna LEO satellites serve one single-antenna mobile user through one fixed ground passive reflecting RIS (N=64-512, b-bit phases); LoS; 19 GHz, 100 MHz (pp. 3, 10).
method: TD3 actor-critic reinforcement learning (continuous actions); reward is analytic energy efficiency minus a phase-change penalty; state holds EKF-predicted position and channels (pp. 6, 8-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: free-space LoS and RIS-reflected paths, constant-velocity user motion; only a 25 dB clutter loss is from 3GPP TR 38.811; no dataset (pp. 3, 10).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated LEO setting; sweeps over RIS size, satellites, mobility noise, planning horizon, reward weight; no unseen-scenario test (pp. 10-14).
baselines: Non-learned: random RIS phases, EKF with heuristic beam steering, analytical upper bound; learned: TD3-only without EKF, a module ablation of the proposed method (pp. 10, 14).
metrics: Energy efficiency (bit/J), EE gain over random phases, SNR-prediction NMSE, transmit-power saving, throughput, coverage probability, critic loss (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Order of growth per decision: EKF O(M), calibration O(1), TD3 actor forward pass O(N+M); a few 10^4 floating-point operations per decision (Table II, p. 15).
q1_support: p. 10: "A shadowing (clutter) loss of 25 dB is incorporated based on the 3GPP NTN channel model" - only this loss comes from TR 38.811; the channel is otherwise free-space LoS plus a RIS path with custom geometry (p. 3), so a custom simulator.
q2_support: p. 14: "an independent agent is trained" - for each reward weight; the paper reports no train-on-A, test-on-B or fine-tuning experiment for the TD3 controller, only sweeps over N, M, q, and horizon (pp. 11-13).
q3_support: p. 14: "Fig. 10 presents an ablation study" - the only learned comparator is TD3-only without EKF (scheme B), i.e. the proposed method minus a module; the other baselines are non-learned (random phases, EKF with heuristic steering, analytic bound, p. 10).
q4_support: p. 15: "ORDER-OF-GROWTH PER-DECISION COMPLEXITY OF THE MAIN COMPONENTS" - Table II gives O(M) for the EKF, O(1) for calibration, O(N+M) for the TD3 actor; text adds a few 10^4 floating-point operations per decision.
q5_support: p. 10: "parameters and TD3 hyperparameters are reported in Table I for" reproducibility - only parameters are listed; no code or data link is given, and the channels are self-simulated.
notes: Included, area 6 by the tie-break order (6 before 3): the learned function is RIS phase control (area 3) in a LEO satellite downlink. Only the TD3 controller is learned; the EKF and the affine SNR calibration are classical. q1 is borderline: only a 25 dB clutter loss is taken from TR 38.811 (p. 10), the rest is a custom free-space model, so the reviewer may confirm. q3 is 0 because TD3-only is an ablation of the proposed method (Fig. 10, p. 14).
